suggested_change: Clarify carry-forward logic: 'Prior scores persist only if no contradictory evidence exists in new call. For Criterion 3, define score floor: 'Functional pain without urgency or stated consequence = 2–3/10; 5/10 requires either urgency signal OR explicit justification.' For Criterion 4, define 'actionable': '[TBD] actions must include channel, timing window (day), and escalation trigger with owner.'
